background_setting: A narrow residential alley paved with light gray asphalt, flanked by low walls, fences, and the sides of modest buildings. There are no raised curbs, only a solid yellow painted edge line marking the road boundary. Utility poles and overhead wires punctuate the route, with one wooden telephone pole standing flush with the pavement right at the right edge line ahead. Scattered debris, patches of moss along wall bases, and dappled greenery from small yards add texture. The scene is bathed in clear, bright daytime light casting consistent, sharp shadows across the asphalt.

temporal_caption: At 0:00 the ego vehicle rolls slowly forward down a narrow, curb-less alley in bright daylight, gently drifting toward the solid yellow edge line on the right as if pulling over. By 0:02 a weathered wooden telephone pole standing flush with the pavement at the right edge line becomes clearly visible directly ahead of the vehicle's right side; the vehicle recognizes it and begins to brake. From 0:03 onward the vehicle steers left to keep well clear of the pole, and over the final two seconds it maintains a safe gap while easing into a cautious, slow pull-over, the pole sliding safely toward the right edge of the frame. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.
